The '''Order of Yun-Yammka''' was the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[priest caste]] order that served [[Yun-Yammka]]. During the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleias]], [[Tsavong Lah]] promised to devote [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] to the order after the battle.
